title: Funko Pop! Disney - Star Wars - Valentine Kylo Ren #591 With Protector
descriptionText:
Some sticker residue on the front of the box. 

Add this limited edition Funko Pop! Disney Star Wars Valentine Kylo Ren #591 to your collection today. This highly sought-after vinyl figure is part of the Star Wars Valentines S3 series and features Kylo Ren in a unique Valentine's Day outfit. The box number is 591 and the model number is 67612.

This Pop! Vinyl figure is a must-have for any Star Wars fan and collector. It comes with a protector to keep it safe from any damage. Celebrate your love for the sci-fi franchise with this exclusive item. Get it now before it's too late!
